schema: Coverage domains, not active implementation stages. Dependencies are planning hypotheses; exact function ownership is tracked separately.

modules.name: Instruction semantics and calling conventions
modules.treatment: Translate engine instructions; implement explicit ABI and memory model
modules.evidence: Automatic projection/callback/frustum/lookup/CRC slices; scalar-SSE repairs
modules.next_gate: Opcode census and conformance fixtures for remaining SIMD, atomics, flags, stack layouts and indirect transfers
modules.ownership: Register/FP state, stack, pointer provenance, native/generated transitions
modules.parallel: Thread-local execution state and FP environment; no shared simulated CPU

modules.name: Startup, initialization and shutdown
modules.treatment: Recover engine lifecycle; provide a deliberate launcher/platform entry boundary
modules.evidence: Entry point lies in .bind; static .text analysis does not prove startup
modules.next_gate: Inventory ordered initializers, config, singleton creation, dependency failure and teardown; boot an owned minimal lifecycle
modules.ownership: Process globals, initialization order, shutdown dependencies and callbacks
modules.parallel: Keep ordered bootstrap/teardown until independent tasks and completion dependencies are proven

modules.name: CRT, exceptions, RTTI and TLS
modules.treatment: Translate embedded runtime behavior or use declared matching native runtime bridges
modules.evidence: One cleanup-only MSVC scope and real loader TLS/CRT synchronization pass
modules.next_gate: Nested destruction, catches/rethrows, stack guards, alternate funclets, thread creation/destruction and runtime ABI
modules.ownership: Per-thread epochs and runtime state; cleanup of partially built objects
modules.parallel: Each worker needs valid TLS, FP/runtime state and exception propagation/cleanup policy

modules.name: Allocation, pools and object lifetime
modules.treatment: Translate allocators and lifetime rules before redesign
modules.evidence: MemoryManager labels exist; no allocator or lifetime workflow validated
modules.next_gate: Allocate/construct/use/destroy/free; aligned allocations; reuse; allocation-failure cleanup and cross-thread release
modules.ownership: Pool ownership, free lists, arena epochs, reference counts and destruction affinity
modules.parallel: Document which allocator/object can move between workers and when reclamation is safe

modules.name: Containers, strings, hashing and math
modules.treatment: Translate helpers; retain or replace CRT imports with explicit semantics
modules.evidence: CRC helpers, string-lookup bridge and selected camera/actor-value math pass
modules.next_gate: Container growth/erase/iteration, interning, locale/Unicode, sorting and numerical edge cases
modules.ownership: Backing storage, intern tables, iterator validity and cached values
modules.parallel: Read-only snapshots or explicit exclusive ownership for mutable collections

modules.name: Jobs, synchronization, time and random state
modules.treatment: Translate existing scheduling behavior; redesign only behind separately verified contracts
modules.evidence: One six-thread/five-waiter static initialization protocol passes; no general scheduler proof
modules.next_gate: Identify existing workers, queues, locks, completion events, frame clocks, random streams, cancellation and shutdown
modules.ownership: Queue ownership, lock order, event delivery order, frame epochs and random-state mutations
modules.parallel: Explicit dependencies and deterministic publication; measure contention rather than assuming the engine is wholly serial

modules.name: Object model, handles, factories and virtual dispatch
modules.treatment: Translate layouts and dispatch contracts; retain compatible native boundaries where required
modules.evidence: One virtual callback/receiver boundary passes; RTTI byte matches provide class hypotheses
modules.next_gate: One real object graph with factories, handles, refcounts, vtables, callbacks and destruction
modules.ownership: Stable identity, handle generation, graph ownership and callback reentrancy
modules.parallel: Resolve raw-pointer escape and shared mutable object graphs before moving work

modules.name: Files, archives and resource streams
modules.treatment: Translate resource/VFS behavior; bridge OS I/O; preserve existing archive content
modules.evidence: BSResource SDK surface and installed BSA packages observed; no loader proof
modules.next_gate: Loose/archive override resolution, stream seek/read, decompression, malformed input, async completion and cancellation
modules.ownership: File handles, stream position, resource cache entries and request lifetime
modules.parallel: Read/decompress independent resources in workers; publish only fully constructed resources

modules.name: Plugin records, FormIDs and load order
modules.treatment: Translate record loaders, link/fixup and override semantics; preserve ESM/ESP/ESL data
modules.evidence: Installed master/light-plugin files and TESDataHandler SDK surface; not validated
modules.next_gate: Master dependencies, light IDs, overrides, localized strings, references, malformed records and duplicate definitions
modules.ownership: Form registry, ID allocation, fixup tables and final override selection
modules.parallel: Parse independent records separately; deterministic linking and publication must preserve load-order semantics

modules.name: Asset decoding and caches
modules.treatment: Translate readers/decoders and object construction; preserve or deliberately convert content formats
modules.evidence: SDK asset/resource classes; format inventory is incomplete
modules.next_gate: Inventory NIF/mesh/texture/animation/material/font/audio/UI/shader inputs; decode one asset family through construction and release
modules.ownership: Decoded buffers, shared asset caches, deduplication and eviction
modules.parallel: Independent decode is a candidate; cache registration and GPU/scene attachment require owned handoff

modules.name: Cells, references, streaming and LOD
modules.treatment: Translate world lifecycle and streaming state machines
modules.evidence: TES/cell/streaming SDK names provide hypotheses; no real world workflow
modules.next_gate: Load/link/attach a cell; stream neighboring cells; unload while requests/callbacks are outstanding
modules.ownership: Live cell/reference graphs, attachment state, streaming request lifetimes and LOD links
modules.parallel: Prepare detached cell content off-thread; attach/detach through explicit scene/world ownership barriers

modules.name: Terrain, vegetation, water and world geometry
modules.treatment: Translate generation/loading/query behavior and renderer/physics integration
modules.evidence: Terrain/grass/water/collision SDK families; unvalidated
modules.next_gate: One terrain tile including collision, vegetation/LOD and water transitions with resource lifetime checks
modules.ownership: Terrain meshes, grass instances, water state, collision attachment and cache invalidation
modules.parallel: Tile preparation is a candidate after immutable inputs and deterministic attachment are defined

modules.name: Weather, climate, lighting and world time
modules.treatment: Translate update rules and their simulation/presentation dependencies
modules.evidence: Weather/climate SDK families; unvalidated
modules.next_gate: Advance controlled world time through weather transitions and compare dependent light/audio/event state
modules.ownership: Shared world clock, climate state, lighting parameters and event order
modules.parallel: Calculate from a stable frame snapshot; commit a consistent environment state

modules.name: Actors, values, movement and process state
modules.treatment: Translate actor state and update behavior
modules.evidence: Actor-value lookup/clamp slices only; no integrated actor simulation
modules.next_gate: One actor creation/update/movement/damage/death/destruction path with callbacks and stable identity
modules.ownership: Actor process state, movement, values, active effects and cross-actor references
modules.parallel: Partition only after cross-actor effects and movement/physics publication are explicit

modules.name: AI, perception, packages and navigation
modules.treatment: Translate decision-making and navigation behaviors
modules.evidence: AI/package/navmesh SDK surfaces; unvalidated
modules.next_gate: One deterministic perception/path/decision/action sequence with changing obstacles and actor interactions
modules.ownership: Perception caches, actor package stacks, navmesh queries and action side effects
modules.parallel: Read-only query/decision work may use snapshots; ordered world mutations need explicit commit semantics

modules.name: Combat, magic, perks, effects and projectiles
modules.treatment: Translate gameplay rules and observable ordering
modules.evidence: Effect/casting/gameplay SDK labels; unvalidated
modules.next_gate: One attack/spell through hit detection, modifiers, effects, events and cleanup; compare event order and RNG use
modules.ownership: Targets, health/effects, projectile ownership, event queues and random streams
modules.parallel: Parallel queries/calculation require stable snapshots; damage/effect commits must preserve defined ordering

modules.name: Inventory, equipment, crafting, economy and progression
modules.treatment: Translate state changes and presentation/script/save connections
modules.evidence: Inventory/equipment/crafting SDK surface; unvalidated
modules.next_gate: Acquire/equip/use/remove an item with effects, UI updates, script events and persistence
modules.ownership: Container entries, stacks, equipment graphs, currency, progression and notifications
modules.parallel: Keep multi-object transactions coherent; do not split ownership-dependent mutations arbitrarily

modules.name: Quests, dialogue, scenes, factions and crime
modules.treatment: Translate state machines and condition/event evaluation
modules.evidence: Quest/dialogue/faction SDK families; unvalidated
modules.next_gate: One quest/dialogue transition with conditions, aliases, scene actions, faction/crime effects and reload
modules.ownership: Quest stages, alias bindings, dialogue state and ordered cross-system effects
modules.parallel: Evaluate pure conditions on snapshots; transitions and their side effects require ordered publication

modules.name: Animation, behavior graphs, skeletons and skinning
modules.treatment: Translate embedded behavior/runtime and loading; preserve existing animation content
modules.evidence: Animation/behavior/Havok SDK types; unvalidated
modules.next_gate: Load one skeleton/graph, advance animation, emit events, apply root motion and release resources
modules.ownership: Graph instances, pose buffers, root motion, event ordering and actor/physics coupling
modules.parallel: Per-instance pose evaluation is a candidate with immutable inputs and separate output buffers

modules.name: Physics, collision, ragdolls and character controllers
modules.treatment: Translate embedded physics code or explicitly replace its behavior boundary
modules.evidence: Havok RTTI/type surfaces observed; no physics equivalence
modules.next_gate: Construct/step/query/destroy a small world; contacts, raycasts, activation, characters and animation coupling
modules.ownership: Physics world locks, bodies, islands, contact callbacks and deferred mutations
modules.parallel: Recover existing engine/middleware threading rules first; behavioral replacement has its own equivalence burden

modules.name: Papyrus VM, bytecode and native bindings
modules.treatment: Translate VM/runtime and native functions; execute existing PEX content
modules.evidence: BSScript/SkyrimVM SDK families; no VM execution proof
modules.next_gate: Execute a script with native calls, latent suspension/resume, events, handles, collection and save/load
modules.ownership: VM stacks, handles, object bindings, scheduler queues and native call thread affinity
modules.parallel: VM internals may be concurrent already; native game mutations need explicit affinity and ordering contracts

modules.name: Events, callbacks, conditions and console commands
modules.treatment: Translate dispatch/registration and observable ordering
modules.evidence: One callback bridge and ordered lookup trace; no general event system proof
modules.next_gate: Register/dispatch/unregister with reentrancy, receiver destruction, deferred work and shutdown
modules.ownership: Subscriber lists, callback captures, deferred queues and reentrant mutation
modules.parallel: Use ordered messages where justified; never move callbacks without auditing their state and thread assumptions

modules.name: Scene graph, transforms, cameras and visibility bounds
modules.treatment: Translate graph operations and camera math
modules.evidence: Projection and frustum/cache slices pass; scene graph/lifetimes remain untested
modules.next_gate: Construct/update/clone/cull/detach/destroy one real scene graph and observe dependent caches
modules.ownership: Parent-child links, transforms, dirty flags, camera/frame cache and node lifetime
modules.parallel: Stable graph snapshots or ownership partitions before parallel transform/culling work

modules.name: Renderer preparation, materials and draw ordering
modules.treatment: Translate renderer CPU behavior; change scheduling only after visual equivalence
modules.evidence: D3D11/DXGI imports and renderer SDK families; no frame rendered
modules.next_gate: One repeatable rendered frame with materials, shadows, visibility, transparency and resource updates
modules.ownership: Material caches, render lists, scene snapshots, pass dependencies and GPU resource lifetime
modules.parallel: Partition independent preparation; preserve transparent ordering, pass dependencies and publication boundaries

modules.name: GPU resources, shaders, command submission and presentation
modules.treatment: Bridge D3D11/DXGI initially; preserve shader behavior or explicitly port/rewrite it
modules.evidence: D3D11/DXGI/D3DX imports; shader-cache directory; no GPU validation
modules.next_gate: Inventory shader variants and resource formats; create/upload/draw/present/resize/device-recover with visual comparisons
modules.ownership: Device contexts, command lists, textures/buffers, fences and swap-chain ownership
modules.parallel: One context at a time per D3D11 context; independently owned deferred contexts are a design candidate, not a proven speedup

modules.name: UI, Scaleform/ActionScript, menus, text and localization
modules.treatment: Translate embedded UI integration/runtime or provide an explicit compatible replacement; preserve UI assets
modules.evidence: GFx/Scaleform SDK families; unvalidated
modules.next_gate: Load one menu/movie, display localized text, deliver input/native callbacks, close and recreate it
modules.ownership: Movie/menu state, font caches, UI callbacks and game-state bindings
modules.parallel: Respect UI ownership; off-thread preparation must not mutate live movie/game state unexpectedly

modules.name: Audio, music, dialogue, spatial sound and lip sync
modules.treatment: Translate audio scheduling/integration; bridge native audio backend or explicitly replace it
modules.evidence: X3DAudio imports and audio SDK families; backend dynamic/COM paths not fully resolved
modules.next_gate: Decode/play/position/stop one sound; dialogue/music transitions, callbacks, device loss and resource release
modules.ownership: Audio voices, mix/control queues, callback affinity and shared timing
modules.parallel: Owned audio-thread command handoff; independent decode is a candidate after lifetime/cancellation proof

modules.name: Input, window events, controls and camera interaction
modules.treatment: Translate mapping/game control behavior; bridge Windows/HID/controller APIs
modules.evidence: USER32/DINPUT/XINPUT/HID imports; no input workflow
modules.next_gate: Capture/replay ordered input through focus, menus, rebinding, game controls and disconnect/reconnect
modules.ownership: Window/input thread, ordered device events, mappings and frame sampling
modules.parallel: Capture input centrally and publish immutable input frames; preserve observable event order

modules.name: Video playback and movie integration
modules.treatment: Translate engine integration; retain supplied Bink backend or explicitly replace playback behavior
modules.evidence: Nine Bink imports and installed Bink DLL; unvalidated
modules.next_gate: Open/play/skip/close a movie with synchronized audio, input and teardown
modules.ownership: Decoder buffers, audio/video clocks and presentation ownership
modules.parallel: Backend-supported decode queues only; synchronization/lifetime must remain explicit

modules.name: Save/load, serialization and versioned state
modules.treatment: Translate serialization and restore semantics; preserve existing save contracts deliberately
modules.evidence: Save/load SDK wrappers call original engine functions; no save proof
modules.next_gate: Round-trip a minimal state including handles/scripts/references; load original saves; interrupted writes and missing/modded content
modules.ownership: Consistent world/VM snapshot, reference fixups, background writes and load barriers
modules.parallel: Capture a coherent owned snapshot before background serialization; define quiescence and resume explicitly

modules.name: OS APIs, runtime imports and dynamic libraries
modules.treatment: Explicit native bridges or replacements; do not translate the OS/drivers themselves
modules.evidence: Complete pinned static import table; one actual CRT bridge and selected OS synchronization calls exercised
modules.next_gate: Disposition every import, dynamic LoadLibrary/GetProcAddress target, COM interface, callback ABI and failure behavior
modules.ownership: OS handles, callbacks, COM apartment/thread affinity and native resource teardown
modules.parallel: Respect each API's threading contract; bridge boundaries do not automatically make calls thread-safe

modules.name: Steam, achievements, Creations and online services
modules.treatment: Translate engine integration; retain explicit platform interfaces or document feature replacements
modules.evidence: Steam/WinHTTP/WS2/crypto imports; service paths not exercised
modules.next_gate: Map startup/offline/failure/callback behavior and feature-specific state; no silent successful stubs
modules.ownership: Platform callbacks, request state, service caches and shutdown order
modules.parallel: Async service requests with explicit completion/callback ownership; offline policy must be a deliberate product decision

modules.name: Data, script, asset and UI mods
modules.treatment: Preserve loader/format/native-script contracts; test existing mod content explicitly
modules.evidence: Two historical MO2 instance inventories; no mod compatibility execution
modules.next_gate: Curated data/script/asset/UI cases with override priority, native-function bindings and save round trips
modules.ownership: Load-order state, VM/UI extension hooks and content cache invalidation
modules.parallel: Changes must preserve callback/event ordering relied on by content and scripts

modules.name: SKSE, native DLL plugins, hooks and binary patches
modules.treatment: Translate/port selected extension behavior or preserve a deliberately supported ABI/hook boundary
modules.evidence: Native-plugin sample inventories; no plugin DLL loaded; older/current runtime versions differ
modules.next_gate: Per-plugin inventory of patches, overwritten behavior, addresses/layouts, trampoline calls, APIs, thread assumptions and co-saves
modules.ownership: Untracked raw pointers, direct memory writes, arbitrary detours and callbacks into engine state
modules.parallel: Arbitrary old binary patch compatibility may constrain layout/scheduling changes; source-port or narrowed stable APIs need explicit support policy

modules.name: Renderer injectors, shader extensions and engine-fix behavior
modules.treatment: Catalogue each extension/fix; retain compatible hooks or implement its intended behavior explicitly
modules.evidence: EngineFixes/DisplayTweaks/CommunityShaders and other sampled plugin metadata; no behavior absorbed
modules.next_gate: Separate bug fix from workaround; map intercepted renderer/runtime paths and validate visual/behavior/performance regressions
modules.ownership: Renderer hooks, resource interception, timing changes and extension-owned state
modules.parallel: Audit hook affinity and reentrancy before concurrent rendering/resource work; API interception can impose serialization

modules.name: Creation Kit, launchers, compilers and developer tools
modules.treatment: Keep external tools initially; map their output/runtime contracts rather than blindly translating every installed executable
modules.evidence: Creation Kit/launcher/Papyrus compiler installed; not surveyed as engine runtime dependencies
modules.next_gate: Confirm required generated content and workflow compatibility; classify any newly discovered runtime-linked dependency
modules.ownership: Tool outputs, versioned formats and build provenance
modules.parallel: External authoring/build parallelism is separate from live-engine scheduling

modules.name: QA, diagnostics, builds and reproducibility
modules.treatment: Authored verification tooling; no game behavior translation
modules.evidence: Native differential gates, negative controls, source/input/artifact hashes and clean public reproduction pass
modules.next_gate: Expand to connected subsystem traces, long-run lifetime checks, save/visual/audio compatibility and performance profiles
modules.ownership: Repeatable fixtures, oracle separation, test-state isolation and evidence provenance
modules.parallel: Race-sensitive tests need controlled schedules plus adversarial stress; exact and modified-behavior oracles remain separate

modules.name: Unassigned code/data and dynamically discovered behavior
modules.treatment: Explicit investigation queue; never treat unknown or unexecuted behavior as unnecessary
modules.evidence: All discovered functions/ranges are indexed; most ownership/signatures and indirect transfers remain unverified
modules.next_gate: Resolve function owners, signatures, all executable gaps, virtual/callback targets, dynamic loading, data references and trigger coverage
modules.ownership: Unknown global reads/writes, pointer escapes, ordering and callbacks
modules.parallel: No concurrency admission until transitive effects and ownership are established
